best: Power paths (3V3 buck, 5 V buck, four-switch stage with input caps, half-bridges, inductor and output caps, and the protection-FET chain) are drawn as wired left-to-right paths under clear block titles.
worst: Cells sheet: parts stacked on the BQ40Z50 left pins (R113/TH101/TH104 thermistors, C105, R104) and R115/R116/R117 on the right overlap each other and their text, so refs and values there are unreadable.

Many small parts float alone tied only by labels (D101, D401 TVS, Q409, Q103, R432, TS connectors, MCU pull-ups hung on the 3V3 rail far from their lines, USB decoupling caps in a separate row), forcing net search.

Uneven use of space: large empty areas (bottom of USB and MCU sheets, middle of Cells) while pin numbers/labels collide at U401/U403 (gate resistors R444-R447, R412-R414) and USB text is small on the huge sheet.
